W.note: Clean violet-blue pill with blurred aurora halo, bloom overshoot and arrow reveal, solid focus and reduced-motion, but the resting button is a little plain and the effect is fairly standard.

X.note: Pale pearl plate with slow breathing glow, letter-spacing drift and long exhale curves feels genuinely ethereal with a dark legible label, strong focus ring and thorough reduced-motion, though the exit is very slow.

Y.note: Glass pill with iridescent rim, spark icon rotating and a glow that keeps arriving after the lift stops, asymmetric breath curves and clear exit, full-width on mobile with good focus and reduced-motion handling.

Z.note: Pretty light pastel card with gradient sweep and spinning blur, but at peak hover the white label washes out against the pale gradient, hurting legibility.
